annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2086 laying down procedural rules and templates for joint clinical assessments of medical devices and diagnostic medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2086 laying down procedural rules and templates for joint clinical assessments of medical devices and diagnostic medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU implementing regulation setting procedural rules, deadlines, expert and stakeholder involvement, personal-data rules and templates for joint clinical health technology assessments of medical devices and in vitro diagnostics under Regulation (EU) 2021/2282. Not AI-specific; only a template field mentions machine-learning functions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets deadlines for dossier submission (100 days), scope finalisation, and report finalisation (165 days).
Requires notified bodies and developers to share certification information with the HTA secretariat.
Sets rules for selecting individual experts, conflict-of-interest checks and confidentiality agreements.
Makes the Commission data controller and sets personal-data retention limits.
Annexes give dossier, report and summary templates, including a description of ML/AI functions in devices.
